name: uplift-ui
description: Restyle an existing web frontend into a modern, responsive interface with its own identity, without breaking its behaviour. Tokens with light/dim/dark, 12 palettes, 4 flavours, ~80 motion classes, popups, info tips, paged tables, empty states, illustrations, surfaces, blocks, React components, a static audit scanner, a WCAG contrast checker and a guide for Angular, Vue and component libraries.
